title: Disparate Impact Diminishes Consumer Trust Even for Advantaged Users
findings: The paper has no findings related to religion. Its focus is on how gender-based disparate impact from an AI system affects consumer trust, finding that both advantaged and disadvantaged users lose trust when faced with unfairness.
